purpose: Complete current first-party registry regression gate, separate from actual menu operations and the historical Excel function catalog.

methodology.expectedValues: Reuse existing assertions; add hand-calculated fixed results or documented stochastic bounds only for uncovered functions. No self-generated calculation oracle and no third-party runtime.
methodology.scenarioDiscovery: TypeScript literal formula ASTs in Core calculation scenario files; parser/copy-only tests excluded. Scenarios are linked source evidence, not a substitute for running their tests.
commands: cd packages/core && bun run test src/tests/formula src/tests/commands/filter-wps-conditions.test.ts
excludes: Exhaustive per-function combinations or locale coercion
All 240 functions executed in each desktop application

actualMenuInventory.distinction: Toolbar controls and menu commands are not the function count. Category and browser function entries are registry-derived.

officialComparisons.finding: Both exclude filtered-out rows and nested subtotals. The filter regression fixture's visible 10 and 9 therefore sum to 19, not 20.
Both document the fractional-day time representation; 0.5 denotes noon. Time-part extraction must preserve fractions. Text time parsing remains outside the current strict numeric contract.
Both document interpolation for nonmatching x; inclusive and exclusive endpoint formulas remain distinct. The symmetric middle fixture has an independently derived rank of 0.5 in either form.
Official Microsoft worked example -10,-3 gives -9, opposite signs give NUM. Decimal midpoint ambiguities are intentionally not treated as an exact parity promise.
